metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM parser for CrowdStrike Falcon Data Replicator
properties.query:
let EventMap = datatable(event_simpleName:string, EventType:string, ObjectType:string, ObjectCategory:string) [
    "FirewallDeleteRule", "Delete", "Policy Rule", "FirewallRule",
    "FirewallSetRule", "Set", "Policy Rule", "FirewallRule",
    "FirewallChangeOption", "Set", "Configuration Atom", "FirewallOption",
    "FirewallEnabled", "Enable", "Configuration Atom", "Firewall",
    "FirewallDisabled", "Disable", "Configuration Atom", "Firewall",
    "ConfigStateUpdate", "Set", "Configuration Atom", "Configuration",
    "CriticalEnvironmentVariableChanged", "Set", "Configuration Atom", "EnvironmentVariable",
    "HostnameChanged", "Set", "Configuration Atom", "Hostname",
    "MemoryScanEnabled", "Enable", "Configuration Atom", "MemoryScan",
    "FileVaultStatus", "Read", "Configuration Atom", "FileVault",
    "ActiveDirectoryAccountCreated", "Create", "Directory Service Object", "Account",
    "ActiveDirectoryAccountEnabled", "Enable", "Directory Service Object", "Account",
    "ActiveDirectoryAccountDisabled", "Disable", "Directory Service Object", "Account",
    "ActiveDirectoryAccountLocked", "Set", "Directory Service Object", "Account",
    "ActiveDirectoryAccountUnlocked", "Set", "Directory Service Object", "Account",
    "ActiveDirectoryAccountPasswordUpdate", "Set", "Directory Service Object", "Account",
    "ActiveDirectoryAccountDepartmentUpdate", "Set", "Directory Service Object", "Account",
    "ActiveDirectoryAccountNameUpdate", "Set", "Directory Service Object", "Account",
    "ActiveDirectoryAccountOuUpdate", "Set", "Directory Service Object", "Account",
    "NetShareAdd", "Create", "Other", "Share",
    "NetShareDelete", "Delete", "Other", "Share",
    "NetShareSecurityModify", "Set", "Other", "Share",
    "EventLogCleared", "Clear", "Event Log", "EventLog",
    "VolumeSnapshotCreated", "Create", "Other", "VolumeSnapshot",
    "VolumeSnapshotDeleted", "Delete", "Other", "VolumeSnapshot",
    "DcUsbDeviceWhitelisted", "Set", "Policy Rule", "UsbDevice",
    "DcUsbDeviceDisconnected", "Stop", "Other", "UsbDevice",
    "DcBluetoothDeviceConnected", "Start", "Other", "BluetoothDevice",
    "DcBluetoothDeviceDisconnected", "Stop", "Other", "BluetoothDevice",
    "IOServiceRegister", "Create", "Service", "IOService",
    "ProvisioningStarted", "Start", "Service", "Provisioning",
    "ProvisioningEnded", "Stop", "Service", "Provisioning",
    "ManifestDownloadComplete", "Other", "Other", "ManifestDownload",
    "InstallBundleDownloadComplete", "Other", "Other", "InstallBundleDownload",
    "InstallServiceDownloadComplete", "Other", "Other", "InstallServiceDownload",
    "OsfmDownloadComplete", "Other", "Other", "OsfmDownload",
    "LfoUploadStart", "Start", "Other", "Upload",
    "FileCreateInfo", "Create", "Other", "File",
    "FileDeleteInfo", "Delete", "Other", "File",
    "FileRenameInfo", "Set", "Other", "File",
    "FileOpenInfo", "Read", "Other", "File",
    "SmbClientShareOpenedEtw", "Start", "Other", "SmbShare",
    "SmbClientShareClosedEtw", "Stop", "Other", "SmbShare",
    "SmbServerShareOpenedEtw", "Start", "Other", "SmbShare",
    "IoSessionConnected", "Start", "Other", "IoSession"
];
CrowdStrike_Audit_Events_CL
| where not(disabled)
| where isnotempty(event_simpleName)
| lookup kind=leftouter EventMap on event_simpleName
| extend EventType=coalesce(EventType, "Other"), ObjectType=coalesce(ObjectType, "Other"),
    ObjectCategory=coalesce(ObjectCategory, "Unclassified")
| extend _Host=coalesce(ComputerName, tostring(AdditionalFields.ComputerName)),
    _LocalIp=tostring(AdditionalFields.LocalAddressIP4),
    _RemoteIp=coalesce(RemoteAddressIP4, RemoteAddressIP6),
    _EventTime=coalesce(unixtime_milliseconds_todatetime(timestamp), TimeGenerated)
| extend _Hostname=tostring(split(_Host, ".")[0]),
    _SrcHostname=tostring(split(coalesce(ClientComputerName, SmbClientName), ".")[0])
| extend DvcHostname=iff(_Hostname matches regex @"^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,61}$", _Hostname, ""),
    DvcDomain=iff(_Host contains ".", substring(_Host, indexof(_Host, ".")+1), ""),
    DvcFQDN=iff(_Host contains ".", _Host, ""),
    DvcIpAddr=coalesce(_LocalIp, aip),
    SrcHostname=iff(_SrcHostname matches regex @"^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,61}$", _SrcHostname, ""),
    SrcFQDN=iff(coalesce(ClientComputerName, SmbClientName) contains ".", coalesce(ClientComputerName, SmbClientName), ""),
    SrcDomain=iff(coalesce(ClientComputerName, SmbClientName) contains ".", substring(coalesce(ClientComputerName, SmbClientName), indexof(coalesce(ClientComputerName, SmbClientName), ".")+1), ""),
    ActorUsernameType=case(isempty(UserName), "", UserName contains "\\", "Windows", UserName contains "@", "UPN", "Simple"),
    DvcOs=case(event_platform == "Win", "Windows", event_platform == "Mac", "macOS", event_platform == "Lin", "Linux", ""),
    EventResult=case(Status in~ ("Success", "Succeeded"), "Success", Status in~ ("Failure", "Failed"), "Failure", "NA")
| extend Object=case(
    ObjectCategory == "FirewallRule", coalesce(FirewallRule, FirewallRuleId),
    ObjectCategory == "FirewallOption", FirewallOption,
    ObjectCategory == "EnvironmentVariable", EnvironmentVariableName,
    ObjectCategory == "Account", coalesce(SamAccountName, AccountObjectSid, AccountObjectGuid),
    ObjectCategory in ("Share", "SmbShare"), coalesce(SharePath, ShareName, SmbShareName),
    ObjectCategory == "File", coalesce(SourceFileName, TargetFileName),
    ObjectCategory == "VolumeSnapshot", coalesce(VolumeSnapshotName, VolumeName),
    ObjectCategory == "UsbDevice", coalesce(DeviceInstanceId, DeviceSerialNumber, DeviceProduct),
    ObjectCategory == "BluetoothDevice", coalesce(BluetoothDeviceAddress, DeviceInstanceId),
    ObjectCategory == "IOService", coalesce(IOServiceName, IOServicePath),
    ObjectCategory == "Upload", UploadId,
    ObjectCategory == "IoSession", SessionId,
    ObjectCategory == "Unclassified", "",
    ObjectCategory),
    ObjectId=case(
    ObjectCategory == "FirewallRule", FirewallRuleId,
    ObjectCategory == "Account", coalesce(AccountObjectGuid, AccountObjectSid),
    ObjectCategory in ("UsbDevice", "BluetoothDevice"), DeviceInstanceId,
    ""),
    NewValue=case(
    event_simpleName == "FirewallChangeOption", coalesce(FirewallOptionStringValue, FirewallOptionNumericValue),
    event_simpleName == "CriticalEnvironmentVariableChanged", EnvironmentVariableValue,
    event_simpleName == "ConfigStateUpdate", ConfigStateData,
    event_simpleName == "FileRenameInfo", TargetFileName,
    event_simpleName == "ActiveDirectoryAccountDepartmentUpdate", ActiveDirectoryDepartment,
    event_simpleName == "ActiveDirectoryAccountOuUpdate", ActiveDirectoryOuDn,
    event_simpleName == "ActiveDirectoryAccountNameUpdate", SamAccountName,
    event_simpleName == "NetShareSecurityModify", ShareData,
    event_simpleName == "FileVaultStatus" and isnotnull(FileVaultIsEnabled), tostring(FileVaultIsEnabled),
    event_simpleName in ("FirewallEnabled", "MemoryScanEnabled", "ActiveDirectoryAccountEnabled"), "true",
    event_simpleName in ("FirewallDisabled", "ActiveDirectoryAccountDisabled"), "false",
    event_simpleName == "HostnameChanged", _Host,
    "")
| extend _Packed=iff(pack, bag_pack(
    "timestamp", timestamp, "aip", aip, "aid", aid, "UserName", UserName, "event_platform", event_platform,
    "ContextTimeStamp", ContextTimeStamp, "name", name, "ConfigBuild", ConfigBuild, "CrowdStrikeId", CrowdStrikeId,
    "ConfigStateHash", ConfigStateHash, "ContextProcessId", ContextProcessId, "ContextThreadId", ContextThreadId,
    "BoundingLimitCount", BoundingLimitCount, "BoundingLimitDuration", BoundingLimitDuration, "Entitlements", Entitlements,
    "EffectiveTransmissionClass", EffectiveTransmissionClass, "cid", cid, "OciContainerId", OciContainerId,
    "TreeId", TreeId, "VolumeSnapshotName", VolumeSnapshotName, "SmbShareName", SmbShareName, "ShareName", ShareName,
    "UploadId", UploadId, "SessionId", SessionId, "ComputerName", ComputerName, "FirewallRule", FirewallRule,
    "FirewallRuleId", FirewallRuleId, "FirewallOption", FirewallOption, "SourceFileName", SourceFileName,
    "TargetFileName", TargetFileName, "DeviceVendorId", DeviceVendorId, "DeviceProductId", DeviceProductId,
    "DeviceSerialNumber", DeviceSerialNumber, "BluetoothDeviceAddress", BluetoothDeviceAddress,
    "EnvironmentVariableName", EnvironmentVariableName, "SamAccountName", SamAccountName,
    "FirewallOptionNumericValue", FirewallOptionNumericValue, "FirewallOptionStringValue", FirewallOptionStringValue,
    "FileVaultIsEnabled", FileVaultIsEnabled, "EnvironmentVariableValue", EnvironmentVariableValue,
    "ConfigStateData", ConfigStateData, "ActiveDirectoryOuDn", ActiveDirectoryOuDn,
    "ActiveDirectoryDepartment", ActiveDirectoryDepartment, "SHA256HashData", SHA256HashData, "CommandLine", CommandLine,
    "VolumeName", VolumeName, "VolumeDriveLetter", VolumeDriveLetter, "TokenType", TokenType, "InterfaceGuid", InterfaceGuid,
    "RpcClientProcessId", RpcClientProcessId, "InterfaceVersion", InterfaceVersion, "RpcClientThreadId", RpcClientThreadId,
    "AuthenticationId", AuthenticationId, "ImageFileName", ImageFileName, "RpcOpNum", RpcOpNum,
    "RpcNestingLevel", RpcNestingLevel, "ClientComputerName", ClientComputerName, "DomainName", DomainName,
    "RemoteAddressIP6", RemoteAddressIP6, "RemoteAddressIP4", RemoteAddressIP4, "SmbClientName", SmbClientName,
    "AgentLoadFlags", AgentLoadFlags, "ProvisioningDuration", ProvisioningDuration, "Status", Status,
    "ErrorText", ErrorText, "CloudErrorCode", CloudErrorCode, "SharePath", SharePath, "ShareMaxCount", ShareMaxCount,
    "ShareRemark", ShareRemark, "ShareData", ShareData, "IntelTDTEnabled", IntelTDTEnabled,
    "FalconServiceState", FalconServiceState, "LfoUploadFlags", LfoUploadFlags, "AttemptNumber", AttemptNumber,
    "Size", Size, "Tags", Tags, "CloudRequestId", CloudRequestId, "LocalSession", LocalSession,
    "IOServiceClass", IOServiceClass, "IOServicePath", IOServicePath, "IOServiceProperties", IOServiceProperties,
    "IOServiceName", IOServiceName, "Protocol", Protocol, "ChannelDiffStatusList", ChannelDiffStatusList,
    "AccountDomain", AccountDomain, "AccountObjectGuid", AccountObjectGuid, "AccountObjectSid", AccountObjectSid,
    "TotalCount", TotalCount, "ErrorCode", ErrorCode, "EventOrigin", EventOrigin, "AddressFamily", AddressFamily,
    "BluetoothDeviceType", BluetoothDeviceType, "DeviceTimeStamp", DeviceTimeStamp, "DeviceInstanceId", DeviceInstanceId,
    "BluetoothDeviceAddressType", BluetoothDeviceAddressType, "DeviceVersion", DeviceVersion,
    "DeviceDescriptorSetHash", DeviceDescriptorSetHash, "DeviceManufacturer", DeviceManufacturer,
    "DeviceProduct", DeviceProduct, "DeviceUserSid", DeviceUserSid, "DeviceUserAuthenticationId", DeviceUserAuthenticationId,
    "FirewallProfile", FirewallProfile, "ShareAccess", ShareAccess, "DesiredAccess", DesiredAccess, "GID", GID,
    "UID", UID, "UnixMode", UnixMode, "OriginalAdditionalFields", AdditionalFields,
    "TenantId", column_ifexists("TenantId", ""), "_ResourceId", column_ifexists("_ResourceId", "")), dynamic({}))
| project-rename Operation=event_simpleName, DvcId=aid, DvcScopeId=cid, ActorUsername=UserName,
    ActorSessionId=AuthenticationId, ActingAppId=ContextProcessId, ActingAppName=ImageFileName,
    EventOriginalUid=CrowdStrikeId, EventMessage=ErrorText
| extend Dvc=coalesce(_Host, DvcId, DvcIpAddr), DvcIdType=iff(isnotempty(DvcId), "Other", ""),
    DvcDomainType=iff(isnotempty(DvcDomain), "FQDN", ""),
    SrcIpAddr=_RemoteIp, SrcDomainType=iff(isnotempty(SrcDomain), "FQDN", ""),
    Src=coalesce(SrcFQDN, SrcHostname, _RemoteIp),
    ActingAppType=iff(isnotempty(ActingAppId) or isnotempty(ActingAppName), "Process", ""),
    EventOriginalResultDetails=coalesce(Status, ErrorCode, CloudErrorCode),
    EventStartTime=_EventTime, EventEndTime=_EventTime,
    EventCount=int(1), EventSchema="AuditEvent", EventSchemaVersion="1.0.0",
    EventVendor="CrowdStrike", EventProduct="Falcon Data Replicator", EventSeverity="Informational",
    TargetHostname=DvcHostname, TargetFQDN=DvcFQDN, TargetDomain=DvcDomain,
    TargetDomainType=iff(isnotempty(DvcDomain), "FQDN", ""), TargetIpAddr=DvcIpAddr,
    TargetDvcId=DvcId, TargetDvcIdType=iff(isnotempty(DvcId), "Other", ""), TargetDvcOs=DvcOs,
    TargetDvcScopeId=DvcScopeId, OriginalObjectType=ObjectCategory,
    ActorUserEntityKey="", SrcSystemEntityKey="", TargetSystemEntityKey="", DvcEntityKey="",
    ActingApplicationEntityKey="", TargetApplicationEntityKey="",
    ActorUserAdditionalIds=dynamic([]), AdditionalEntities=dynamic([])
| extend User=ActorUsername, IpAddr=SrcIpAddr, Value=NewValue, Dst=Dvc
| project TimeGenerated, Type=column_ifexists("Type", "CrowdStrike_Audit_Events_CL"), EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventCount, EventType, EventResult,
    EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, EventSeverity,
    EventOriginalUid, EventOriginalResultDetails, EventMessage, Operation,
    Object, ObjectId, ObjectType, OriginalObjectType, NewValue, Value,
    Dvc, DvcId, DvcIdType, DvcScopeId, DvcHostname, DvcFQDN, DvcDomain, DvcDomainType, DvcIpAddr, DvcOs,
    ActorUsername, ActorUsernameType, ActorSessionId, User, ActingAppId, ActingAppName, ActingAppType,
    Src, SrcIpAddr, SrcHostname, SrcFQDN, SrcDomain, SrcDomainType, IpAddr,
    TargetHostname, TargetFQDN, TargetDomain, TargetDomainType, TargetIpAddr,
    TargetDvcId, TargetDvcIdType, TargetDvcOs, TargetDvcScopeId, Dst,
    ActorUserEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey, TargetSystemEntityKey, DvcEntityKey,
    ActingApplicationEntityKey, TargetApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, AdditionalEntities,
    AdditionalFields=_Packed
